newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 GDP growth nears 6.5 pct vs 6.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 GDP growth nears 6.5 pct vs 6.6 pct.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Tuesday the country's GDP (gross domestic product) was expected to grow in 1996/97 at about 6.5 pct against the previous year's 6.6 pct.

"By and large, there is an agreement among the Reserve Bank of India (the central bank), the Planning Commission and my chief economic adviser that the (GDP) growth will be in the region of 6.5 percent or so," he said.
"But the balance of payments is quite comfortable," he said. "Our reserves crossed $19 billion last week."
The finance minister was addressing economic editors in the capital.
